source: Polymarket global data API, walk-forward study in docs/BACKTEST.md

field_definitions.name: display name on Polymarket
field_definitions.league: league code from the event slug prefix (nfl, cfb, nba, atp, cs2, ...)
field_definitions.seg_bets: settled pre-game bets held to settlement in this league+bet type, price 0.05-0.95
field_definitions.seg_flat_roi: mean per-bet return res/entry-1 on those bets (what a flat-stake copy at their price earns before costs)
field_definitions.seg_dollar_roi: stake-weighted ROI on the same bets
field_definitions.shrunk_score: credibility score = empirical-Bayes shrunk seg_flat_roi: mu + tau2/(tau2+v)*(m-mu), v=sum((1-p)/p)/n^2; prior in 'prior'
field_definitions.top_decile: shrunk_score in the top 10% of all segments
field_definitions.wallet_settled: all settled game bets (stake>=$10), any timing
field_definitions.wallet_own_roi: wallet's own all-history PnL / cost (we compute it; leaderboard ROI is ignored)
field_definitions.hold: share of bets held to settlement (sold <10%)
field_definitions.two_sided: share of markets where they bought both sides / split
field_definitions.age_days: days since first activity (floor if history capped)
field_definitions.clv: mean closing-line value (kickoff price - entry) over <=60 sampled pre-game bets
field_definitions.median_stake: median stake of their settled bets (USD)
field_definitions.sizing: size-skill test on clean bets: spearman(stake/median, (res-p)/sqrt(p(1-p))), one-sided p, ROI above vs below median size, flat vs stake-weighted ROI; flag_p05 = all conditions with p<0.05; passes_bh_fdr10 = survives Benjamini-Hochberg at 10% across all tested wallets. No wallet is currently a proven sizer.
field_definitions.status: keep = copied (v3 core wallet in its main league, segment flat ROI>0 over >=30, CLV>0, no totals, shrunk>0); watch = copied at lower confidence (shrunk>0, >=100 bets, no totals, hold>=70%, two-sided<30%, age>=60d, own ROI>=0); drop = not copied
